sections.label: Rocky footing and dragon coil
sections.evidence: Dark-gray bricks spread across y=0–2 beneath the central white footprint. Green bricks at y=2–4 curve around that footprint, with brown bricks marking the tower entrance.

sections.label: Lighthouse entrance and shaft
sections.evidence: Brown #172–173, #177 and #221 occupy the front entrance. White bricks rise through y=3–7 around x=9–16 and z=9–16, alongside small green coil additions.

sections.label: Tower stripe and lantern
sections.evidence: Red bricks form the y=8 tower band; white walls and blue #357, #378 and #382 rise above it. Dark-gray y=13 bricks widen beneath the yellow lantern at y=14–16.

sections.label: Dragon coil and rising neck
sections.evidence: Green additions fill the low curve around the tower and rise at x=2–10 through y=6–12. Tan #283 borders this rising mass; higher green pieces extend toward the head.

sections.label: Dragon head and wings
sections.evidence: Green bricks form a projecting head at x=4–12, z=3–13, y=13–16. Orange bricks spread behind the neck through z=12–23 and y=8–14, forming broad wing surfaces.

sections.label: Lantern wall and roof edge
sections.evidence: Yellow and dark-gray bricks form the lantern side at x=14, y=14–16. Red #508 and #515 extend above it at y=17.

sections.label: Dragon tail and horns
sections.evidence: Green #149, #206 and #208 taper along z=18–20 at y=2–3. Paired tan stacks #496/#510 and #497/#511 rise beside the head at y=16–17.

sections.label: Lighthouse trim and dragon tail
sections.evidence: Red #512 and #521 form the roof center and tip; #336 completes a tower-band edge. Green #150 and #152 extend the low tail, while #428 fills the gray lantern platform.

sections.label: Dragon eyes
sections.evidence: Black #471 and #474 sit at matching y=15 and z=7 positions on opposite sides of the green head, at x=5 and x=10.

sections.label: Lighthouse crown and rocky rim
sections.evidence: Red y=17 bricks complete broad roof areas above the dark-gray y=13 platform. Other additions extend the dark-gray y=1 ground perimeter and neighboring green coil.

sections.label: Outer dragon coil
sections.evidence: Green additions at x=20–21, z=8–16 and y=2–5 fill the outside of the curve beside the tower, above dark-gray #57.
